args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18% following the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production. Post-rollback health checks pass and error rate is back to 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back:** All production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification shows the service is healthy again with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the health check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation — the incident remains open for follow-up.
